provenance: Only official-URL water records plus independently reconciled history; original records retained
decision: Saved disjoint threshold block; precision>=.2 and event recall>=.8; >=2 events
reference: No current thresholds backfilled into historical data; no invented upstream gauge topology
target_scope: Confirmed NONE at forecast origin only; exact match to live new-issuance eligibility
station_context: Training-only same-gauge median, p05/p95 range and p90; no current flood thresholds backfilled into history. Unknown gauges keep NaN context and an explicit missing flag for HGB.
candidate_selection: Saved 2025 selection AP only; numerical Brier and threshold checks unchanged
hypothesis: Seasonal warning prevalence and official issuance-hour patterns vary; known origin-time cycles may improve discrimination without upstream assumptions. Paired ablation against the previous best selection-AP model; all other parameters unchanged.
limitation: Temporal associations can reflect agency practice, not flood physics; no independent accuracy claim.
